residual_findings: Hosted facts measured read-only after the head (not changed here): (1) hosted daily_bars has traded_value null for every row on 481 of 484 days and volume null on collector rows, because daily_bars_store reads volume and value while collector rows carry volume_shares and turnover_twd; with the liquidity rule the hosted boundary is empty and fails closed as market_boundary_empty until DAILY-BARS-COLLECTOR-VOLUME-VALUE-20261125 lands; (2) available_time is present on all 484 days; (3) TWSE symbols start 2025-03-20 or 2025-03-21 (about 410 bars, 2330 has 411) and TPEx symbols start 2024-11-27 (483 to 484 bars), so the gate's 480 bars and 730 days cannot be met for TWSE symbols yet.

Hosted proof (three consumers on real stored data, hosted memory.peak of research-orchestrator-svc and persona) is for the coordinator after deploy. The hosted store was not read here; thresholds (60 bars, 20 days, TWD 5,000,000 median traded value, 7 days stale) are engineering defaults chosen for the boundary of SD_STRATEGY_SCREEN_ENTRY_EXIT section 2 and are recorded in the amendment; the operator may tune them.

The card distillation env (PANTHEON_L2_CARD_DATASET_ID, defaulting to PERSONA_POOL_SOURCE_DATASET_ID) must name governed-market:tw-daily or tw_price_daily for new cards; the resolver also accepts tw_price_daily, the logical dataset name the old default carried. A card pinned to a persona DatasetVersion id now resolves to nothing (fails closed with dataset_id_not_governed_market; the worker drops the binding). Outside this task's artifact list.

services/research/alpha_replication/revalidation_worker.py (one call site, passes the rule's own symbols to the resolver) and services/control-plane/persona/main.py (does not publish a governed market dataset as a DatasetVersion pointer) were edited although not listed; both are required by the design.
alpha-replication-worker mounts source-ingest-data read-write (seed store path). The builder only reads; making the mount read-only needs the seed store moved first.

An available_time of null (a v1 partition) leaves the bar out and counts it in bars_not_point_in_time; if hosted history is mostly v1 the boundary will be empty and fail closed with market_boundary_empty or symbols_not_in_store naming the reason.

A one-symbol rule is given companion instruments (most liquid in the boundary) because the backtest backends require two instruments; the rule trades only its own symbols (companion_symbols names them).
Outside scope, not changed: _default_retrain_dataset_loader (Retrain) still reads the DatasetVersion pointer; its pointer is now written only by real DatasetVersion producers.
